answer_1.quote: Motivated by tasks commonly addressed by CRM personas: service manager, service agent, and service analyst, CRMArena comprises nine tasks that reflect real-world CRM scenarios.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include agent recommendations, identification of performance metrics, disambiguated product orders, policy violation determinations, answers to knowledge-based questions, trend analyses, and region or time-based case volume summaries.

answer_2.quote: For the knowledge QA task, since it is an open-ended text generation task, we use F1 scores. For the remaining tasks, we only need to compare the predicted and ground truth object IDs; therefore, an exact match is used.

answer_3.quote: If the LLM correctly identifies the product, we retain the entry; otherwise, it is discarded.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a user study involving ten experts with diverse professional backgrounds who have experience working on Salesforce Orgs daily.
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated the realism of our Org environment compared to the real-world systems they are accustomed to. They also provided detailed rationales for their ratings.
